vetSays.line: 🛡️ Jessica, Karim, Elke, Mara and Xavier met them at the door — 5 put down. Jessica, Karim, Elke, Mara, Xavier are hurt.
🛡️ Jessica, Reagan, Elke and Xavier met them at the door — 4 put down. Jessica, Reagan, Elke, Xavier are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elke just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Elke, Xavier and Nadia met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Xavier didn't come back. Elke is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Katarina just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jessica just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mia just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ursula just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ursula met them at the door — 1 put down. Ursula is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Omar was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Maya taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Zoltan has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Maya drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ivy just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ivy and Victor met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Victor is hurt.
🛡️ Ivy met them at the door — 1 put down. Ivy is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ablade just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ablade and Emilly met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Ablade, Emilly are hurt.
